text:
```yaml
name: Debug Push Permissions

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  debug:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Log environment details
      run: |
        echo "GitHub Action running on runner $RUNNER_OS"
        echo "Current branch: $GITHUB_REF"

    - name: Check authentication status
      run: |
        curl -I https://api.github.com/user/repos?visibility=public

    - name: Get branch protection rules
      id: get_branch_protection
      run: |
        gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}/protection --jq '.'
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        OWNER: reactivando
        REPO: validations-br
        BRANCH: main

    - name: Print branch protection rules
      run: echo "::set-output name=branch_protection::${{ steps.get_branch_protection.outputs.body }}"
```
